That's the right behavior. Saving shouldn't stop just because the page didn't hand over its details — the important thing is that the link itself gets kept so I don't lose it. Pasting that private address still saved it, using the site name and a simple stand-in image, with a clear notice telling me the details couldn't be gathered, and the editor right there so I can fill in a proper title and description myself. That's exactly what I'd want: keep the link no matter what, be honest that some details are missing, and let me fix them.

Making me supply everything before it'll save would just get in my way — sometimes I'm saving something quickly to deal with later. So yes, save it with sensible fallbacks and let me correct it. Good.
